decisions.rationale: The complete technical compound directly attests harsh speech. Its source members have unique complete English words inside this parent.

The whole intention/manner construction supplies purposely. Its exact query has zero entries; the component references and identical local conditions support the phrase, without relocating the misleading MA NOR BAR mined purposely gloss.
The actual negative particle supplies without, distinct from purposeful intent. Any is the English quantificational support, not a separate source word.

The complete negative-adjective phrase directly attests unpleasant. Keep it whole at d3; SNYAN PA good/pleasant reference material does not license a prohibited interior pleasant word span.
This independent TSHIG supplies words, not the speech member of the earlier compound. The following genitive and meaning are separately represented in the English anaphora.

The explicit GI linking words to meaning is recast as the possessive anaphor their. The exact glossary includes their, and its local antecedent is the already selected words; this is not a newly invented participant.

The whole agentive phrase supplies by the other person, exactly as in358. Preserve the POS ending intact; no split agentive-s or d7 member of this grammatical phrase.
GO BA directly supplies understood. Current source says too, whereas C16:877 has to; that other-row difference is not a reason to alter this correct current English or the Tibetan predicate.
